description:
Turn every visitor into a lead with a single satisfying spin. Lucky Wheel is a fast, mobile-friendly promotional game built for campaigns, storefront pop-ups, and email capture funnels.

Visitors tap once to spin a fully branded prize wheel. The wheel slows to a stop on a weighted-random prize, then hands off straight into a lead-capture form so you walk away with a contact and a completed conversion in one interaction.

Business & Conversion Inquiries

Looking to deploy this game for your next marketing campaign? This template includes enterprise-grade features designed for seamless brand integration and lead generation:

  • Configurable Prize Table: Set up to 12 segments with custom labels, win odds, and prize values entirely from the flat JSON configurator layer — no code required.

  • Embedded Lead Gen Overlays: GDPR-compliant capture forms built with Tailwind CSS, triggered automatically the moment a prize is won.

  • Fully Branded Assets: Replace the pointer, center hub, and wheel rim with your own artwork, or let the wheel render with theme-matched procedural graphics out of the box.

  • Ultra-Lightweight Footprint: Optimized for instant loading via Cloudflare Pages or secure iframe embedding within existing web environments.

Game Features

  • Weighted Randomness: Every segment carries its own odds, so you control exactly how often each prize is awarded.

  • One-Tap Spin: Players tap the center hub or the start screen CTA to spin — zero friction, zero instructions needed.

  • Satisfying Motion: A tuned multi-rotation easing curve makes every spin feel weighty and rewarding.

  • Instant Lead Handoff: The moment the wheel stops, the prize and its value are handed to the overlay layer for lead capture or scorekeeping.
tutorial:
Getting started

Configure the number of segments, their labels, odds, and prize values from the Studio sidebar under "Wheel setup". Adjust spin duration and minimum rotations under "Spin behavior" to match your brand's pacing. Upload a pointer, center hub, or rim image to replace the default procedural artwork.
